title: Apple says China iPhone ban would force settlement with Qualcomm
text: Apple says China iPhone ban would force settlement with Qualcomm Friday, 14 December 2018 ( 10 hours ago ) Apple Inc. said a Chinese ban on the sale of some models of the iPhone will force it to settle a long and bitter licensing battle with Qualcomm Inc., according to a recent legal filing. Earlier this week, a court in China ruled that Apple is infringing two Qualcomm patents and issued injunctions against the sale of six versions of the iPhone in the country. Apple said on Monday it had filed a request for reconsideration with the court. “Apple will be forced to settle with the Respondent,... A Chinese court has ordered a sales ban of some older Apple iPhone models in China for violating two patents of chipmaker Qualcomm. Fred Katayama reports.
